11000.full:
καπηλεύω
(κάπηλος, a huckster, cf. Isa.1:22 (LXX), Sir.26:29)
to make a trade of (RV, mg., make merchandise of), or perhaps (cf. Isa, l.with) to corrupt (RV, tit.): 2Co.2:17.†
(AS)

11001.full:
συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν
(συνίστημι),
__1. for putting together, constructive.
__2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), 2Co.3:1.†
(AS)

11002.full:
μέλαν, τό, see: μέλας.
μέλας, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: Sng.1:5, Zec.6:2 (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;]
black: Rev.6:5, 12; opposite to λευκός, Mat.5:36; neut., τὸ μ., ink : 2Co.3:3, II Jn 12, 3Jn.13.†
(AS)

11004.full:
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, Exo.39:30) A * ;]
to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, 2Co.3:7.†
(AS)

11006.full:
κατοπτρίζω
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror),
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2Co.3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†
(AS)

11007.full:
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word),
to make new: 2Co.4:16, Col.3:10 (see Cremer, 323).†
(AS)

s: to have on over, be clothed upon
11008.full:
ἐπ-εν-δύω
= -δύνω (Hdt.),
to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: 2Co.5:2-4.†
(AS)

s: to live in a place, be at home
11010.full:
ἐνδημέω, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place),
to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, 2Co.5:6 5:9; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, 2Co.5:8.†
(AS)

11011.full:
ἐκ-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἔκδημος, from home; cf. -ία, 3Ma.4:11)*;
to be from home, absent: 2Co.5:6; before ἀπό, 2Co.5:8; before ἐκ, 2Co.5:9 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).†
(AS)

s: to be the elder, to take precedence
11012.full:
πρεσβεύω
(πρέσβυς),
__1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
__2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2Co.5:20, Eph.6:20.†
(AS)

11013.full:
προσκοπή, -ῆς, ή
(προσκόπτω), [in Gr. Ven.: Pro.16:18 (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;]
an occasion of stumbling, offence: 2Co.6:3.†
(AS)

11015.full:
εὐφημία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔφημος), [in Sm.: Psa.42:5 47:2 100:2 126:2 * ;]
good report, praise: opposite to δυσφημία, 2Co.6:8.†
(AS)

11016.full:
ἑτερο-ζυγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX cf. ἑτερόζυγος, Lev.19:19 (יְקַמְעָם)* ;]
to be unequally yoked: metaphorically, with dative of person(s), 2Co.6:14.†
(AS)

11017.full:
συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ
(συμφωνέω),
concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), 2Co.6:15.†
(AS)

11021.full:
ἀγανάκτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀγανακτέω), [in LXX: Est.18:3 א 1 * ;]
indignation: 2Co.7:11 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

11022.full:
προ-ενάρχομαι
to begin before: 2Co.8:6; with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, 2Co.8:10 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

11023.full:
πέρυσι
adv. (πέρας),
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), 2Co.8:10 9:2.†
(AS)

11024.full:
συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-)
to send together with: with accusative and dative, 2Co.8:22; id. before μετά, with genitive, 2Co.8:18.†
(AS)

11029.full:
αὐτάρκεια, -ας, ἡ
(αὐτάρκης, which see),
__(a) sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), 2Co.9:8;
__(b) contentment: 1Ti.6:6.†
(AS)

s: to fill up by adding to, to supply fully
11030.full:
προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Wis.19:4 * ;]
to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: 2Co.9:12 11:9.†
(AS)

11033.full:
ἐγ-κρίνω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κρίνω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
to reckon among : ἑαυτούς, 2Co.10:12.†
(AS)

11034.full:
ἄμετρος, -ον
(μέτρον),
without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, 2Co.10:13 10:15†
(AS)

11036.full:
ὑπερ-έκεινα
comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, Pr., 99),
beyond: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, 2Co.10:16 (Byz. and Ecc.1:1-18.).†
(AS)

s: to grow numb; to be inactive, be burdensome
11038.full:
κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ
(ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, Gen.32:25 (26); without Heb. equiv., Gen.32:32 (33) Job.33:19, Dan LXX 11:6*);
__1. to cause to grow numb.
__2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, 2Co.11:9 12:13-14; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).†
(AS)

11041.full:
ναυαγέω, -ῶ
(ναῦς, + ἄγνυμι, to break)
to suffer shipwreck: 2Co.11:25; metaphorically, before περὶ τ. πίστιν, 1Ti.1:19.†
(AS)

s: lasting a night and a day
11042.full:
νυχθήμερος, -α, -ον
(νύξ, ἡμέρα, see B1., § 28, 4),
lasting a night and a day; as subst., (τὸ) ν., a night and a day: 2Co.11:25 (pl., Or. Sib., 8, 203).†
(AS)

11043.full:
ψευδ-άδελφος, -ου, ὁ
a false brother: of professing Christians, 2Co.11:26, Gal.2:4.†
(AS)

s: a hamper, a basket made of ropes
11045.full:
σαργάνη, -ης, ἡ
__1. a plaited rope (Æsch.).
__2. a hamper, a basket made of ropes: 2Co.11:33.†
(AS)

11046.full:
ἄρρητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ῥητός, ῥέω), [in Sm.: Lev.18:23 * ;]
__1. unspoken (Hom., al.).
__2. unspeakable (Hat., al.; frequently in Inscr.; MM, see word): 2Co.12:4.†
(AS)

11047.full:
ἥδιστα, see: ἡδέως.
ἡδέως
adv. (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: Pro.3:24 (עָרַב), etc. ;]
gladly, with pleasure: Mrk.6:20 12:37, 2Co.11:19; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), 2Co.12:9 12:15.†
(AS)

s: to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over
11048.full:
ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ
to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaphorically, before ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), 2Co.12:9.†
(AS)

11049.full:
εκ-δαπανάω, -ῶ
strengthened form of δαπανάω, to spend wholly; pass., with reflexive force, to spend oneself wholly: before ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:15.†
(AS)

11050.full:
κατα-βαρέω, -ῶ
to weigh down: metaphorically, with accusative of person(s), 2Co.12:16.†
(AS)

s: a puffing up, swelling with pride
11051.full:
φυσίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(φυσιόω),
a puffing up, swelling with pride: pl., 2Co.12:20.†
(AS)

11053.full:
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ
(καταρτίζω),
a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, 2Co.13:9.†
(AS)

s: one of the same age, an equal in age
11054.full:
συν-ηλικιώτης
(ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.),
one of the same age, an equal in age: Gal.1:14.†
(AS)

s: to lay on or offer besides
to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides
11055.full:
προσ-ανα-τίθημι
to lay on or offer besides; mid.,
__(a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides;
__(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Gal.1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)
(AS)

s: to play a part with, dissemble with
11057.full:
συν-υπο-κρίνομαι
to play a part with, dissemble with: with dative, Gal.2:13 (Polyb.).†
(AS)

11058.full:
ὀρθοποδέω, -ῶ
(ὀρθό-πους, going straight),
= cl. εὐθυπορέω, to walk straight: metaphorically, Gal.2:14 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

s: to add provisions to a document
11062.full:
ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι
to add provisions to a document: Gal.3:15 (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).†
(AS)

s: a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time
11064.full:
προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον
[in Sm.: Job.28:3, Dan.9:26 * ;]
appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: Gal.4:2.†
(AS)

s: to spit at in disgust, to abominate, loathe
11065.full:
ἐκ-πτύω
__1. to spit out.
__2. to spit at in disgust, to abominate, loathe (= cl. ἀποπτ-, καταπτ-): Gal.4:14.†
(AS)

11068.full:
συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ,
to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to: Gal.4:25 (see Lft., in l).†
(AS)

11069.full:
πεισμονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(πείθω),
persuasion: Gal.5:8.†
πείθω,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;]
__(i) Active;
__1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., Mat.28:14, Act.19:26; before περί, with genitive of thing(s), Act.19:8; with accusative of person(s), Act.12:20 14:19 18:4, 2Co.5:11, Gal.1:10; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, 1Jn.3:19; with accusative before περί, Act.28:23; with accusative and inf., Act.13:43 26:28 (see Field, Notes, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), Mat.27:20.
__2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: with accusative and inf., Rom.2:19; with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l) : Php.1:6, 25; with dative, Php.1:14, Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., 2Co.10:7; before ἐν, Php.3:3-4; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, Php.2:24; ἐπί, with dative, Mat.27:43 (WH, mg.), Mrk.10:24 (T, WH, R, mg., om.), Luk.11:22 18:9, 2Co.1:9, Heb.2:13; ἐπί, with accusative, Mat.27:43 (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, 2Co.2:3, 2Th.3:4 (see Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, Gal.5:10.
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
__1. to be persuaded, believe (see M, Pr., 158) : absol., Luk.16:31, Act.17:4 21:14, Heb.13:18; with dative, Act.28:24; with accusative and inf., Act.26:26; so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, Heb.6:9; with accusative and inf., Luk.20:6; ὅτι, Rom.8:38, 2Ti.1:5 1:12; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, Rom.14:14; περί, with genitive before ὅτι, Rom.15:14.
__2. to listen to, obey: with dative of person(s), Act.5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11, Rom.2:8, Gal.5:7, Heb.13:17, Jas.3:3 (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†
(AS)

s: to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly
11070.full:
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.),
__1. to say before: Gal.1:9, 1Th.4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Heb.4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co.7:3 13:2, Gal.5:21; of prophecy, Mat.24:25, Mrk.13:23, Act.1:16, Rom.9:29, 2Pe.3:2, Ju 17.
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†
(AS)

11072.full:
προ-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 A * ;]
to call forth.
Most frequently in mid.,
__(a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: Gal.5:26;
__(b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

11073.full:
φθονέω, -ῶ
(φθόνος), [in LXX: Tob.4:7, 16 AB * ;]
to envy: with dative (L, txt., Tr., mg., WH, mg., accusative), as in cl., Gal.5:26.†
(AS)

11074.full:
φρεν-απατάω, -ῶ
(φρεναπάτης),
to deceive one's mind (Lft., deceive by fancies, see Ga., l.with): with accusative of person(s), Gal.6:3.†
(AS)

s: to look well, make a fair show
11075.full:
εὐ-προσωπέω, -ῶ
(εὐπρόσωπος, fair of face), [in Al.: Psa.141:6, seel. for -ίζω* ;]
to look well, make a fair show: metaphorically (as in 7.; see Deiss., LAE, 96), Gal.6:12.†
(AS)

11076.full:
λοιπός, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
the remaining, the rest,
__1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., Mat.25:11, Act.2:37, Rom.1:13, al.; absol., Mat.22:6, Mrk.16:13, Luk.24:10, al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), Act.28:9, 1Th.4:13, Rev.2:24; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), Rev.9:20; τὰ λ., Mrk.4:19, Rev.3:2, al.
__2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
__(a) for the future, henceforth: Mrk.14:41, 1Co.7:29 (Lft., Notes, 232 f.), Heb.10:13; anarth. (Deiss., LAE, 17616, 1885, 20), Act.27:20, 2Ti.4:8; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, Pr., 73; Bl., § 36, 13), Gal.6:17, Eph.6:10;
__(b) besides, moreover, for the rest: Php.3:1 4:8; anarth., 1Co.1:16 4:2, 1Th.4:1 (M, Th., in l; Lft., Notes, 51)
(AS)

11078.full:
κυριότης, -ητος, ἡ
(κύριος),
lordship, dominion: Eph.1:21, 2Pe.2:10, Ju 8; pl., Col.1:16 (cf. Lft., Col; Mayor, Ju., in ll.; DB, i, 616 f.).†
(AS)

s: to make alive or quicken together with
11079.full:
συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-,
to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph.2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Col.2:13.†
(AS)

s: In the NT , of the heathen, without God, not knowing God
11080.full:
ἄ-θεος, -ον,
__1. in cl.
__(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word);
__(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.);
__(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.)
__2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12.
† (AS)

11081.full:
μεσότοιχον, -ου, τό
(μέσος, τοῖχος)
a partition wall: Eph.2:14 (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).†
(AS)

11082.full:
ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω
(cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with),
to reconcile completely: Eph.2:16, Col.1:20-21.†
(AS)

11083.full:
συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ
a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Eph.2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†
(AS)

11084.full:
συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ
(ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω,
to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Eph.2:21; of the members of the body, Eph.4:16 (Eccl.).†
(AS)

11086.full:
συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον,
partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), Eph.3:6; with genitive of person(s), Eph.5:7 (Arist.).†
(AS)

s: much variegated, of greatly differing colours
11087.full:
πολυ-ποίκιλος, -ον
__1. much variegated, of greatly differing colours (Eur.).
__2. manifold: Eph.3:10.†
(AS)

11090.full:
κυβία (Mt. -εία, and so Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(κύβος, a cube, a die),
dice-playing; metaphorically, trickery, sleight: Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

11091.full:
μεθ-οδία (Rec. -εία; cf. 131., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(† μεθοδεύω, 1. to treat by rule. 2. to employ craft: 4Ki.19:27 *)
craft, deceit: Eph.4:14 6:11 (not found elsewhere; see AR, in l).†
(AS)

s: to cease to feel pain for
11093.full:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ
__1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61).
__2. In late Gk.
__(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5);
__(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Eph.4:19.†
(AS)

11096.full:
εὐτραπελία, -ας, ἡ
(εὖ, τρέπω),
__1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.).
__2. = βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry (Abbott, Essays, 93): Eph.5:4.†
SYN.: μωρολογία, see Tr., Syn., § xxxiv (AS)

s: to have fellowship with or in
11097.full:
συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), Eph.5:11, Rev.18:4; id. with genitive of person(s), Php.4:14.†
(AS)

11098.full:
κρυΦῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
secretly, in secret: Eph.5:12.†
(AS)
